descriptions.w3d_command_create_1: In a particular AI state (or for value 49), queues an AI command of type 1 carrying the given value.
descriptions.w3d_command_create_3: Queues an AI command of type 3 with a value and a zero point, then clears a flag and refreshes the world map.
descriptions.w3d_command_create_7: Queues a type 6 command with count 100, then queues an AI command of type 7 without parameters.
descriptions.w3d_command_create_6: Queues an AI command of type 6, clamping a negative count to zero before storing it.
descriptions.w3d_command_create_15: Queues an AI command of type 15 carrying one integer value.
descriptions.w3d_command_create_17: Queues an AI command of type 17 carrying a copied 3D point.
descriptions.w3d_command_create_18: Queues an AI command of type 18 carrying a value and the current team setting.
descriptions.w3d_command_create_19: Queues an AI command of type 19 without parameters.
descriptions.w3d_command_create_21: Queues an AI command of type 21 without parameters.
